10 · Questions

Before you book.

Something else? Write to hello@mainstage.events. We answer within a day.

Contact us

  • Every pass covers all three days, every talk on every stage, lunch, coffee and the talk recordings. Pro adds two workshops, front rows and the opening party. VIP adds the speaker dinner, a backstage tour and the hotel shuttle.

    Tickets

  • Passes are refundable until 30 days before doors. After that you can transfer your pass to a colleague at no cost, until 48 hours before doors open.

    Tickets

  • Yes. Groups of five or more get 15% off, and every order comes with a VAT invoice. Write to us and we will set it up the same day.

    Tickets

  • Every main-stage talk is recorded and sent to pass holders within two weeks. Workshops are not recorded.

    Programme

  • Workshops are small, hands-on sessions with limited seats. Pro and VIP passes include two; General pass holders can add one at checkout while seats last.

    Programme

  • All talks and workshops are in English. Live captions run on the main stage screens.

    Programme

  • Pavilhão do Rio is 12 minutes from Lisbon airport by metro and a short walk from the riverfront hotels. The Venue page has routes, parking and step-free access.

    Venue & travel

  • Yes. Three partner hotels within a kilometre hold rooms at a fixed rate until 1 April. The booking links are on the Travel page.

    Venue & travel

  • We have Headline, Gold and Community packages, each with a booth and passes. See the sponsor page for what is left, or write to us for the deck.

    Sponsors
